description: This file contains the implementation of the AWS SDK client class 'AwsClient' in PHP, which manages configuration, middleware, endpoint resolution, and request signing for AWS service interactions.

classes.name: AwsClient
classes.description: Default AWS client implementation providing configuration, middleware, endpoint resolution, and signing functionalities for AWS service requests in PHP.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list managing middleware for the client.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Gets the client's configuration options, or specific option if specified.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns the credentials used by the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the configured service endpoint URI.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the configured region for the client.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the API service description object.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a command object for a specified operation.

methods.name: getEndpointProvider
methods.description: Returns the endpoint provider used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getClientContextParams
methods.description: Provides client context parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getClientBuiltIns
methods.description: Returns built-in values used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prevents serialization of the client instance.

methods.name: getSignatureProvider
methods.description: Returns the signature provider callable for request signing.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses the class name to determine service name and exception class.

methods.name: addEndpointParameterMiddleware
methods.description: Adds endpoint parameter middleware to the handler stack.

methods.name: addEndpointDiscoveryMiddleware
methods.description: Adds endpoint discovery middleware if enabled.

methods.name: addSignatureMiddleware
methods.description: Adds request signing middleware.

methods.name: addRequestCompressionMiddleware
methods.description: Adds request compression middleware if enabled.

methods.name: addQueryCompatibleInputMiddleware
methods.description: Adds middleware for query-compatible input validation.

methods.name: addQueryModeHeader
methods.description: Adds header to enable query mode.

methods.name: addInvocationId
methods.description: Adds invocation ID middleware for request tracking.

methods.name: loadAliases
methods.description: Loads operation aliases for the service model.

methods.name: addStreamRequestPayload
methods.description: Adds middleware for streaming request payloads.

methods.name: addRecursionDetection
methods.description: Adds recursion detection middleware.

methods.name: addAuthSelectionMiddleware
methods.description: Adds middleware for authentication scheme selection.

methods.name: addEndpointV2Middleware
methods.description: Adds middleware for EndpointV2 support.

methods.name: addUserAgentMiddleware
methods.description: Appends user agent middleware for request identification.

methods.name: setClientContextParams
methods.description: Sets client context parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: setClientBuiltIns
methods.description: Sets default values for endpoint resolution based on configuration.

methods.name: getEndpointProviderArgs
methods.description: Retrieves arguments for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: normalizeEndpointProviderArgs
methods.description: Normalizes built-in and client context parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: isUseEndpointV2
methods.description: Checks whether EndpointV2 is in use.

methods.name: emitDeprecationWarning
methods.description: Emits a deprecation warning about PHP version and method usage.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Applies filtering and aliasing to the service API model for documentation purposes.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Deprecated static factory method to instantiate the client.
